name: Rifthold
blurb: Capital of Adarlan—glass, smoke, and empire. The Glass Castle crowns a city of canals, assassins' alleys, and the quiet terror of a magic-starved kingdom.

name: Terrasen (Orynth)
blurb: Pine, stone, and stubborn green—the homeland Aelin would burn the world to reclaim. Orynth's ruined glory still smells of oakwald wind and unfinished coronations.

name: Wendlyn
blurb: Where magic never fully died. Misty coasts and Fae courts teach fire to a girl who thought she was only an assassin.

name: Doranelle
blurb: Maeve's seat—beautiful as a blade. Rivers of starlight and courts that smile while they bind you.

name: Western Wastes
blurb: Wind-scoured flatlands where Ironteeth hosts break wyverns and softness is a death sentence. Red dust, iron sky.

name: Antica

name: Endovier
